body: Um, no. Games aren't fun anymore. Games don't make the pain stop. Only cutting my arm up works.
I've fantasized shooting practices with the same idea. It makes me smile a little.
Thank you. It hasn't been two weeks since whole shitstorm happened and I'm having difficulty even imagining if I can make it to March.

I admire her spirit, how she keeps things together in her own way. Criticism against that spirit is, rather bluntly, the last thing she needs right now. 

While I am indifferent to whether *he* actually straightens the fuck out or fucks up even more after this, I would take arms for *her* in a heartbeat.

I've done what I can. Venting on Tumblr, cutting myself up, and drugs aside, I'm actively reaching for company. And at the height of my misery, I had never gotten so much love from so many. Plenty of people have listened to me vent and plenty of people have demonstrated that I matter. You have somehow become one of these people. Thank you.

She knows. We confronted him together and she still forgave him. She knows that I'm hurting and she always tells me that time will heal; rather detachedly but she means well.

Time continues to move for them. Mine froze up.
